response.sql: SELECT t.calibrstatus, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes t WHERE t.bandusagepct > 47.6 GROUP BY t.calibrstatus;

assumptions.assumption: "High bandwidth usage" means strictly greater than 47.6 (bandusagepct > 47.6), so a value exactly equal to 47.6 is excluded.
Telescopes with a NULL calibrstatus are grouped into a single NULL group rather than dropped; the request does not say how to handle them.
Telescope count is the number of telescope rows in each group, and average bandwidth usage is computed over the same filtered rows.
